name: Aihara Yuzu
source: An energetic girl, but for some reason she refers to the protagonist as "Onii-chan". She seems to have known the protagonist from before, but she refuse to remind him until the protagonist remembers for himself. She often competes with Hotaru for the position of the protagonist's 'imouto'.
translation: An energetic girl, but for some reason she refers to the protagonist as "Onii-chan". She seems to have known the protagonist from before, but she refuse to remind him until the protagonist remembers for himself. She often competes with Hotaru for the position of the protagonist's 'imouto'.
